patch.value: Add a narrowly scoped maintainer RELEASE_PAT to the GitHub release environment. Do not substitute GITHUB_TOKEN because GitHub suppresses recursive push workflows and protected master may reject it.
Configure RELEASE_PAT for protected automated release pushes
The release environment has NPM_TOKEN but lacks the maintainer token required for Auto Release to atomically push the generated release commit and tag through protected master.
RELEASE_PAT appears in gh secret list --env release; manual Auto Release dry run passes; production push mode can create a release commit and tag through branch protection
Repository owner provides or configures a suitable maintainer token without exposing it in logs.
Requires repository-owner credential configuration outside source control.
Run gh secret list --repo unbraind/searxng-cli --env release; only NPM_TOKEN is listed.
Both NPM_TOKEN and RELEASE_PAT are configured for their separate publication and protected-push responsibilities.
NPM_TOKEN exists; RELEASE_PAT is absent, so scheduled production Auto Release will fail fast before mutation.
New releases cannot be cut automatically until the secret is configured.
